entities.name: covenant
entities.description: A formal agreement or contract that sets specific rules or restrictions, often related to property use or development, such as school site plans or neighborhood agreements.

entities.name: expansion
entities.description: The process of increasing the size, capacity, or footprint of a school or other facility, often requiring approval and documentation to ensure compliance with regulations.

entities.name: enrollment
entities.description: The number of students registered or enrolled in a school, which may be monitored to ensure compliance with covenants or zoning regulations.

entities.name: neighborhood solution
entities.description: Strategies or measures implemented to address neighborhood issues, such as traffic, safety, or environmental concerns, requiring community input and cooperation.

entities.name: swale package
entities.description: A set of plans or proposals for installing swales, which are shallow, vegetated channels designed to manage stormwater runoff and improve drainage in neighborhoods.

entities.name: public safety
entities.description: Measures and policies aimed at protecting residents and property, including law enforcement, emergency response, and safety regulations.

entities.name: drop-off and pick-up
entities.description: Procedures and arrangements for the safe and efficient dropping off and picking up of students at schools.

entities.name: traffic congestion
entities.description: The overcrowding of vehicles on roads, leading to delays and safety concerns, often addressed through planning and infrastructure improvements.
